title: Check-In at Registration When You Arrive
body:
Please check-in at registration when you arrive in Portland!

Registration is located in the Oregon Lobby at the entrance of the Oregon Convention Center during the following times:

Sunday          3:00pm - 6:00pm
Monday         7:30am - 6:00pm
Tuesday        7:30am - 6:00pm
Wednesday  8:00am - 6:00pm
Thursday       8:00am - noon
seoTitle: OpenStack Summit Portland 2013 — Check-In at Registration When You Arrive
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
